import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int res = 0;

        for (int i = n; i-- > 0; ) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            res += a;
        }

        System.out.println(res / n);
        sc.close();
    }
}
